title: Employ staff under the Pharmacy Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Pharmacy Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Pharmacy Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 This industry award covers, to the exclusion of any other modern award: (a) employers in the community pharmacy industry throughout Australia; and (b) employees (within a classification defined in Schedule A —Classification Definitions ) of employers mentioned in clause 4.2(a) .

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Pharmacy Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 In this industry award, community pharmacy means a business to which all of the following apply: (a) the business is established wholly or partly for compounding or dispensing prescriptions for, or selling medicines or drugs to, the general public from the premises on which the business is conducted, whether or not other goods are so sold from those premises; and (b) if required to be registered under legislation for the regulation of pharmacies in force in the place in which the premises on which the business is conducted are located, the business is so registered;

sources.title: Pharmacy Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 In this industry award, community pharmacy means a business to which all of the following apply: (a) the business is established wholly or partly for compounding or dispensing prescriptions for, or selling medicines or drugs to, the general public from the premises on which the business is conducted, whether or not other goods are so sold from those premises; and (b) if required to be registered under legislation for the regulation of pharmacies in force in the place in which the premises on which the business is conducted are located, the business is so registered; and (c) the business is not owned by a hospital or other public institution or operated by government.

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Pharmacy Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
